cue: For v, top teeth touch your bottom lip. For w, round both lips.
For p, use a small puff. For b, feel your voice buzz.
For t, use air. For d, turn your voice on.
For s, keep lips relaxed. For sh, round your lips a little.
For th, let your tongue peek between your teeth.
Keep ship short and relaxed. Smile and hold the sound in sheep.
Keep bit short. Stretch the middle sound in beat.
Cape has a gliding long a sound.
Keep full short. Hold the middle sound in fool.
For f, blow gently. For v, add a buzz.
